source_read: https://www.simmonsbakers.com/nutritional-information (listing, all 147 bakery pages, all 255 made-in-store pages and all 240 option lookups POST /ingredientoptionslookup, fetched fresh 2026-10-09, one request at a time 1.1-1.2 s apart; the site serves no robots.txt, /robots.txt redirects to its home page); 50 products also rendered in headless Chromium with the options clicked and the page's own 'Nutritional data' tab read
not_verifiable: allergens: none are published (link-only: the made-in-store allergen lists leave out the fillings' allergens and the site's ingredient texts are unreliable, e.g. the 'Marinara Meatball' row lists a Korean BBQ chicken recipe and 'Fajita Chicken' has no ingredients), so there were no allergen values to compare; 16 products are not published or checked (9 bakery pages and Speciality Tea answer HTTP 500; 6 syrup drinks force a syrup pick)
notes: Every published and held-back value was compared with the source by my own parsers (not the script's): 137 bakery pages + 9 static drinks/pizza pages, 1,314 values, 0 differences; all 1,185 made-in-store orders re-added from the site's own component rows, 10,665 values, 0 differences (129 more orders print NaN on the site and are not published); 50 orders rendered in the real page, 450 values, 0 differences. Re-running simmons_bakers.py on the fresh pages reproduced data/source byte for byte before my changes. Root cause found: the made-in-store filling rows (salads, chicken tikka, ...) print a kcal figure below their own kJ (the kJ implies 5% to 73% more energy per filling row); 44 published orders sat 7-15% below both their own kJ and their own 4P+4C+9F, so the script now holds back kJ vs kcal beyond the audit's stricter 0.93-1.07 band (was only beyond 15%): 44 orders held back (salads left: 4). Tag fixes in simmons_bakers.py: 3 focaccia orders lacked contains_pork/contains_beef (bacon and beef are in the pick's name and ingredients, not the page title), the vegan mushroom roll had a false contains_pork ('Sausage Roll Mix' seasoning), Pepperoni Pizza is held back because the page says 'Suitable for vegetarians and vegans' while the dish is named pepperoni. Marked ok: Xmas Fruit bar carbs and sugar (1.1 kg bar), Berry Smoothie and Roasted Veg roll sugar+fibre > carbs (as printed). Open: 85 published items print salt 0 g (73 of them over 150 kcal, e.g. a fruit slab): copied as printed, but likely a missing figure. check_chain: 0 errors, 2 warnings explained (Soup Thai Veg and Christmas Rudolph Biscuits: kcal agrees with their own kJ, only the integer macro columns are lower), 0 audit flags. web/public/menus was not rebuilt: re-publish the chain.
